The '''bombardment of Kriselist''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The bombardment==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the urban [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kriselist/Legends|Kriselist]] openly defied the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a result, the planet was bombarded by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]] and fell into ruin.<ref name="RES" />

==Aftermath==
The Empire moved on, deciding that what was left wasn't worth salvaging. However, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] supporters continued to inhabit the shattered cities of the world.<ref name="RES" />
